hooks.eventNoLongRange: While in play no model may make a long-range attack.
hooks.eventOneActionModel: Each player secretly picks one of their own models at the same time; it gets only one Action this round (Quick Actions are unaffected).
hooks.eventLightningStorm: At the end of every round in play, 2 random models are struck; roll the stated dice per victim and apply energy damage. Stays in play until the end icon is rolled.
hooks.eventOneActionEach: Every model may use only one of its two usual Actions this round.
hooks.eventFallOneHeightLower: Falling damage is worked out as if the fall were one height step lower.
hooks.eventAttack: A Consequence attack: resolve the stated skill value and damage on any one model of the owner's choice.

records.name: Dust Cloud
records.text: A choking dust cloud rolls in: for the round no one can make long-range attacks.

records.name: Unbearable Heat
records.text: The heat is oppressive: every player picks one of their models, all at once, and that model gets only one Action this round.

records.name: Lightning Storm
records.text: Lightning hits 2 random models at the end of each round and the storm lingers until the end icon is rolled. The exact dice on the card are read from the CH picture.

records.name: Forest Fire
records.text: Fire sweeps the area: each model may use only one of its two usual Actions.

records.name: Soft Ground
records.text: The ground is soft: falls count as one height step lower.

records.name: Gun for Hire (Consequence)
records.text: The hired mercenary arrives: make this attack on any one model of your choice.

rulings: RULING: Event Flip icon | known for Dust Cloud and Lightning Storm (Flip) and Unbearable Heat (no Flip) from the CH p4 pictures; Gun for Hire's Consequence resolves on top of the deck so its flip is false; every other Event has flip null until the card face is found, and null reads as no Flip | no local source shows the others | Unsourced | CH p4

RULING: Lightning Storm dice | one blue die per victim, 1 energy damage, ending on a star; the card's dice row is small in the CH picture | the errata changes one of its icons without saying which | Unsourced | CH p4; ERR p.18
RULING: Forest Fire and Soft Ground | effects come from the errata/FAQ; flip and flavour are unknown | no card face in a local PDF | Unsourced | ERR p.10, p.18

RULING: Event scope | the 10 starter Events plus Forest Fire and Soft Ground (errata-named) and the Gun for Hire Consequence; Settlement Events (Homestead) and the other wave decks are not entered | the starter slice is the playable one | Confirmed | FCL p1; ERR p.18, p.21
